    THE EXPERIMENT

    Can more applicants recover?

    Both screens keep the same draft and use the same retry logic. The guided screen explains what was saved, where the send stands, and what to do next.

    Success: an applicant receives a confirmed demo receipt within two minutes of seeing an interruption. The experiment also tracks repeated retries and time to receipt.
